verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents outbound webhooks that notify your own systems when something happens in your organization, which is the subscribe-to-events capability. The evidence is a single sentence from an enterprise-features page. The inbound webhook triggers that start an agent are a separate capability and are not credited. Missing for 10: documented event types and payload schemas, how to register a webhook, delivery details (signing, retries), availability beyond enterprise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Outbound webhooks let Gumloop notify **your** systems when something happens in your organization.
